column39: This is an ecohydrology study site located at Trail Creek, within block 2 (treatment = transition, clear-cut) of the ASCC project. The site consists of (1) an above-canopy pole with ET, energy and radiation fluxes, and meteorological sensors, and (2) a below-canopy tripod with soil, snow, and some limited meteorological/radiation sensors. Variables are monitored at half-hour intervals.
